offering_description.value: Viant sells software that helps advertisers and agencies buy, manage and measure digital ad campaigns, including connected TV. Customers can run campaigns through a self-service platform or have Viant manage them. Viant also provides video content data for ad targeting across streaming publishers and ad platforms.

primary_products.value: demand-side advertising software; audience identity and targeting tools; campaign measurement and attribution software; streaming video content data

primary_services.value: managed media buying; campaign execution and optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertising agencies, brand marketing teams, streaming publishers and advertising technology platforms

end_markets.value: advertising and marketing; streaming media; retail; consumer packaged goods; automotive

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: platform fees tied to digital media spending and use of advertising data and tools

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: connects digital ad inventory and data to agencies and brands for automated media buying; service provider: uses client budgets and campaign objectives to buy and optimize digital media for agencies and brands

geography_served.value: US national: United States, its principal market

specialization.value: related lines: programmatic media buying, audience identity, campaign measurement and streaming video data

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and account teams serving advertisers, agencies and media partners; online: self-service web platform for campaign buying and management

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: ad targeting and measurement subject to state consumer privacy laws, including California’s CCPA as amended by the CPRA

notes: The extent of current operations outside the United States is uncertain.
